title: fix(router): merge results of intialUiState with RouteState
body:
**Summary**

Initial UI State can be used to set a default refinement, e.g. an item in a refinement list to be checked. This can be done in parallel to routing, and should merge per index.

related to #4393, but not fixing it, since they want intial UI State to be *written* to the router too, which probably shouldn't be done, since that will cause a navigation as an effect of loading

also related to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/discussions/4455

**Result**

Slightly changed the code so that typescript didn't think the instance was "any"

Before this PR the second new test was failing
